Message:
bpf, tests: Add more ALU64 BPF_MUL tests

This patch adds BPF_MUL tests for 64x32 and 64x64 multiply. Mainly
testing 32-bit JITs that implement ALU64 operations with two 32-bit
CPU registers per operand.
